main: Consumes {st:Charge} Count to apply {st:ChargeForceField} to self and allies.

Applies {st:PhotoElectricity} to enemies, allowing allies to generate more {st:Charge}. This is a current turn effect, so only allies that hit the same target/s after the E.G.O hits will gain the bonus {st:Charge}.
Passive increases {sinner:6}'s max {st:Charge} count, increases the damage on his {st:Charge} S3s and passively heals his SP every turn he isn't hit.
